about_the_game:
Tired of the same old folder icons? Beautifolder is a lightweight yet powerful customization tool that makes your desktop and file explorer more colorful, creative, and uniquely yours.

🌟 Features

  • Drag & Drop Simplicity:
    Drag a folder into Beautifolder to add it;
    Drag it onto an icon and click apply to instantly change its look.

  • Local Icon Support:
    Drop any image into the software to convert it into an icon and expand your collection.

  • My Icons Manager:
    Easily manage, organize, and switch between your saved icons.

  • Steam Workshop:
    Browse and download community-made icons, or upload your own creations to share with the world.

  • Built-in Icon Editor:
    Use templates and creative tools to design custom icons that match your style.

  • Personalized Experience:
    Multilingual interface with full support for light and dark themes.

🎨 Easy to Use

  • Drag in a folder → Add to manager

  • Drag onto an icon → Apply instantly

  • Drag in an image → Turn into a local icon

  • Browse Workshop → Download or share icons

  • Use editor → Create your own style

Beautifolder isn’t just about changing icons — it’s about expressing your creativity.
